scenes.prompt: Create one original landscape 3:2 children's fantasy storybook illustration. Use the two references ONLY for their rich hand-painted watercolor/gouache storybook style and recognizable characters, NOT their compositions. Boy: tousled brown hair, cream shirt, moss-green lace-front waistcoat, brown trousers. Wizard: kindly elderly man, long white beard, blue pointed hat and robe with gold stars, wooden staff tipped by luminous orb and golden swirl. Unicorn: white with golden horn. Beautiful expressive natural anatomy, atmospheric painterly detail, readable silhouettes, warm magical wonder, no text or lettering, no borders. This is a full illustrated story scene, not a character portrait. Inside a tall round wizard's library grown inside an oak tree, dramatic wide interior with spiral stairs and tiny luminous moths. A leather book floats open in midair, its folded parchment map unfurling into a miniature living blue river with tiny trees and bridges. The boy stands on tiptoe at left reaching a feather pen toward the map, delighted and surprised; the wizard at right gently conducts the magic with his staff. View from slightly below, full figures, amber lamplight against green twilight through round windows. The map is an enchanting three-dimensional landscape, no writing.
